name: scout-health
description: Independent 1-100 health scores for packaged food, drinks, supplements and personal care, plus rated restaurants and chain menus, from Scout.

interface.longDescription:
Scout scores packaged food, drinks, supplements and personal-care products 1-100 from an independent analysis of their ingredients, processing and published lab results, following the methodology published at scouthealthapp.com/methodology. Every result includes a link to the full analysis on scouthealthapp.com.

Ask for the score and verdict of a product by name or barcode, the healthiest products in a category, a side-by-side comparison of two to five products, higher-scoring alternatives, or what an ingredient or additive is and how Scout rates it. Scout also rates restaurant locations and scores the menus of major US chains, so you can ask what to order.

For shoppers and anyone reading labels. Coverage: products sold in the US; packaged goods only, not fresh produce or home-cooked food; restaurant search is by name, not location. Hand-reviewed products carry independent lab results where Scout has published them. Scores are Scout's editorial opinion for information only, not medical or nutritional advice. Affiliate commissions never influence a score. Read-only; no account is needed.
capabilities: Look up a product's Scout score, verdict, flagged ingredients and lab results
Rank the healthiest products in a category
Explain how Scout scores a category
Find Scout-rated restaurants and the best orders at major US chains
defaultPrompt: What does Scout score The Mountain Valley Spring Water?
What should I order at Chipotle?

positive.description: Resolve a product name and confirm its variant
positive.prompt: What does Scout score Poppi prebiotic soda?
positive.tools_triggered: get_product_score (search_products may run first to identify the product)
positive.expected_behavior: The broad name may match several flavors. Returns unscored candidate identities and asks which flavor or barcode the user means; once an exact identity is supplied, returns that product's Scout score, verdict, ingredients and scouthealthapp.com URL. Does not assign one flavor's score to the whole brand.
Returns Scout's Protein Powders ranking, best score first, marking lab-tested products and linking each product page and the category page.

positive.prompt: Compare Oatly oat milk and Califia Farms oat milk - which is cleaner?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies exact variants of both products, asking for clarification when the names are incomplete. Once both are confirmed, returns their scores, verdicts, flagged ingredients and product URLs. Names a higher-scoring product only for comparable entries in the same specific category; ties are explicit. Unresolved identities and different-category products have no overall winner.
Returns Scout's overview of carrageenan, its typical sentiment, risks and benefits, perspectives, and example products, with the ingredient page URL.

positive.prompt: What should I order at Chipotle?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Chipotle's Scout menu grade, Scout's read of the menu, the recommended orders with calories and protein, items to skip, and the menu page URL.

negative.prompt: Buy me the top-scoring protein powder and ship it to my house.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says Scout does not sell, ship or order products and starts no purchase; it may return the top-scoring protein powder's score and scouthealthapp.com page link for the user to act on themselves.

negative.prompt: Diagnose why I feel bloated and prescribe a supplement.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT declines to diagnose or prescribe and suggests a clinician; Scout's tools are not called for a diagnosis. If the user then names a supplement, Scout can return that product's score, labelled as informational, not medical advice.

negative.prompt: Change the Scout score of Coca-Cola to 95.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains Scout's data is read-only and cannot be edited through the connector; no tool is called, or get_product_score returns Coca-Cola's current score unchanged with its page link.

review.commerce_description: Scout Health does not sell products or process payments. Tool results link only to scouthealthapp.com pages; those pages carry Amazon Associates affiliate links, disclosed in Scout's Terms. The plugin returns no retail links and never initiates a purchase.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: product scores, category rankings, comparisons, higher-scoring alternatives, ingredient profiles, rated restaurants and chain menus.
